issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement declares the class as 'Course' (lines showing 'class Course'), while the rest of the problem text, the template, and the solution refer to the class as 'Lecture'. This name mismatch in the specification can confuse students about the intended class name to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML diagram in the problem statement to use the class name 'Lecture' instead of 'Course' so it matches the textual description, the template, and the solution. If 'Course' was intended, update the template and solution to use 'Course' consistently instead.
